correction.affected: First transfer preview only. Fresh long-write DFU with a signed command whose length is not divisible by four. The file manager is unaffected.
correction.protocol: Z21 permits arbitrary byte counts for the command object, but each firmware data write must fit the active object and contain integral 32-bit words. A successful 142-byte command probe therefore establishes at most 140 bytes per data write.

hardwareReadComparison.environment: Windows Chrome 158.0.8127.88, native Web Bluetooth. One connected owner LCD, same directory and stable storage generation. Each run reads all 24 files and checks their SHA-256 afterwards. Times exclude device selection and independent hash checks.
hardwareReadComparison.comparison: Mochi original readFileData open/read/close; Allmiibo six groups of four files with generation checks. Both clients delivered complete matching file contents. The file-reading implementation is shared unchanged with Transfer Test 2.

folderUploadModel.mode: New mixed directory, sufficient workspace, 1081 files on simulated storage, interruption after the 33rd stored file, resume and SHA-256 verification of every final file. Existing-directory mode is a different workflow.

signedAppDfuModel.conditions: Same signed public DE4.1 App678 ZIP. Word-aligned Z21 data writes enforced in model. Counts are host GATT writes. No hardware flash time is inferred.
